s2.ptxt: Using SST, install the oxygen sensor to the front exhaust pipe assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.
Insert a new gasket into the exhaust manifold converter as far as it goes by hand.
Using a wooden block and hammer, gradually tap in the gasket until it is flush with the exhaust manifold.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe FR.

s2.ptxt: Connect the exhaust pipe FR with the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust manifold converter and exhaust pipe assembly FR is equal at the front, rear, left and right.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust pipe assembly FR with the 2 bolts.
Check that there are no exhaust gas leaks from the locations shown in the illustration (exhaust pipe joints and each sensor installation area).
